title: Hoover Motor Express v. Clements Paper
shortTitle: Hoover Motor Express v. Clements Paper
summary: A withdrawal need not employ a technical revocation formula.
notes: The offeror’s statement that it might not wish to proceed communicated the lack of continuing assent in the context described. The notes compare such language with tentative negotiations and ask whether the treatments are consistent.
